_comment: The Drift Guide (T-517; Drifting, Decisions, 'The Drift Guide'). Proposals for the playtest, the Driving & Drift Agent's. seconds: how far ahead it predicts. sample_steps: physics steps (0.02 s each) between the arrow's points. width_units: arrow width (1 unit = the car's width). head_length_units / head_width_units: the arrowhead. colour: [r, g, b] gray. max_opacity: the arrow's opacity at its base. fade_bands: the tail-to-tip fade is this many flat opacity steps (hard edges, no smooth gradient). tip_opacity: the share of max_opacity left at the tip. fade_in_seconds / fade_out_seconds: how long it takes to appear when a drift starts and to go when it ends. See game/docs/driving/drift_guide.md.
